summary: On June 8, 2011, World IPv6 Day, several key content providers offered both IPv4 and IPv6 services, and hundreds of organizations took part. The event went largely unnoticed by the public, which suggested no major problems. This informational document reports some measurements of the day from an end-user perspective.

eli5.summary: One day, big websites turned on the new internet addresses to test them. This reports how it looked from regular users' computers.
